lessons.trigger_condition: A non-core WATCH row could retain a high historical activation_score and runtime review used max(seed_activation, evidence_activation), allowing stale or weakened current evidence to be masked by old seed metadata.
lessons.prevention_rule: Treat activation_score only as declarative/audit seed metadata. For every non-core game, runtime promotion and retention must use only the current verified evidence activation score after official/market freshness gates. Core games remain fixed by policy; stale evidence must fail closed to WATCH.
validation_required: tcg_game_registry.py contains current-evidence-only activation for non-core games
a historical seed of 0.99 cannot keep stale Shadowverse evidence promoted
Pokémon ONE PIECE NARUTO remain the only grading-enabled game IDs
mandatory collection job count remains exactly 8
profit guarantee investment-return prediction and market-direction prediction remain false
lessons.safety_boundary: This changes category trust authority, not investment advice. It never predicts profit or price direction, does not invent marketplace depth, and does not enable grading for newly promoted games.

lessons.trigger_condition: One verified tablet observation can emit several feature training rows sharing the same evidence_ref. Row-wise chronological slicing could place rows from that same observation into both train and holdout, making challenger validation loss look better than independent evidence supports.
lessons.prevention_rule: Group rows by evidence_ref, order groups by their latest observation position, keep each group wholly in train or holdout, and fail closed with SCREEN_NEURAL_HOLDOUT_LEAKAGE_HOLD if direct evaluation receives overlapping evidence groups.
validation_required: screen neural architecture remains exactly 17 inputs 12 hidden units and 18 allowlisted outputs
all rows from a single evidence_ref remain in exactly one partition
train and holdout evidence_ref sets are disjoint
direct overlap returns SCREEN_NEURAL_HOLDOUT_LEAKAGE_HOLD and cannot promote
input drift champion-challenger backup and rollback gates remain active
user behavior tracking source generation arbitrary commands Git writes and verification bypass remain forbidden
lessons.safety_boundary: The neural model remains advisory and can only learn from verified surface outcomes. The change reduces validation leakage and does not grant the model source-code mutation, market-direction inference, or direct execution authority.
